card.name: Frequency word after a dose amount
card.fires_on: The frequency word (twice, times) right after a dose amount such as '150 mg' or 'three', especially when a second dose is being compared with a first one. Occasionally a number inside a schedule or dose.

modes.label: Twice/times after mg
modes.description: The word twice or times following a dose in mg, in a list of alternative dosing schedules.
modes.example: in patients with recommended starting dosage of 200 mg twice daily or 150 mg<< twice>> daily, reduce the VERZENIO

modes.label: Number in schedule
modes.description: A digit inside a day or dose expression in a regimen.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a dose amount is followed by how often it is taken, like 'twice' daily.
